asked.item: Is my account broken (analytics says pending)?
When numbers should show on Starter plan

verdict.reason: The pages say what pending means, give the Starter first checkpoint, and confirm TikTok analytics are supported.

steps.text: "Analytics pending" means no metric history is available yet, and it does not establish an account-connection failure.
On Starter, Blotato collects the first metrics up to 1 day after a post publishes.
Until that first checkpoint passes, a recently published post shows no metrics.
Checkpoint times are targets, not a live-refresh guarantee, and TikTok analytics are supported.
